title: Lodovico Birago to Duke of Nevers, 5 April 1571 (Français 3252 — ff36r–37r)

steps.what: George Lasry (with ChatGPT Astra 6 and Anthropic Opus 5.5) transcribed and deciphered the item: 3/3 pages transcribed; 3/3 cipher pages deciphered in part; 923 elements transcribed, 805 identified (87.2%). Report section: see report.

Spot-check against the Gallica image (https://openapi.bnf.fr/iiif/image/v3/ark:/12148/btv1b9060232m/f37/full/1600,/0/default.jpg): Canvas 37 shows f36r of the letter (Italian, "Il sig. Biagio..."), with cipher blocks identical to his crops; faint letter-by-letter interlinear visible over the signs, but I did not decode lines 7-9 sign by sign Verdict: partly confirmed.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): no texts in the repository for George Lasry's result (only the report excerpt in lasry_entry.md); entry added with a summary and a note naming the missing transcription, decryption and key (needs contributor: George Lasry).

texts.summary: Birago reports delayed infantry pay and troop movements, private diplomatic conversations, dealings over Finale and Savona, religious arrests, and a legal dispute.
